summary: First-round backend testing of DapurKita (Smart Grocery & Meal Planner). Created a comprehensive pytest suite (18 test cases) covering auth, household, recipes, fridge, meal plans, grocery (auto-categorize, generate w/ fridge diff, dedupe, real-time sync, cross-household isolation), archive, and history/reuse. Synthetic users + sessions seeded directly in Mongo per test_credentials.md (Emergent OAuth bypass). All 18/18 tests PASSED against the public /api endpoint. No blockers found. /api/auth/session was intentionally not tested (requires real Google OAuth).

minor.issue: If name is empty/whitespace it silently falls back to 'Rumah Kami'. Consider 400 for empty name to prevent accidental blanks.
meal_type is not validated against enum ['Sarapan','Makan Siang','Makan Malam']; any string is accepted.
category is not validated against known set; arbitrary strings pass through (only 'Lain-lain' triggers auto-classify).
No validation for week_start format (invalid date will 500 via strptime). Return 400 on bad input.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Add Pydantic Literal/Enum validation on meal_type and grocery category to reject invalid values with 400.
(Optional / minor) Reject empty household name with 400 instead of defaulting to 'Rumah Kami'.
(Optional / minor) Wrap week_start parsing in POST /api/history/reuse/{week_start} with try/except → 400.
Frontend testing (Expo mobile) is still pending — request a frontend-only round when UI is ready.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 720 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, household, meal_plans, grocery, history) as features grow.
MongoDB _id is correctly projected out ({'_id': 0}) everywhere — good.
week_start_of() correctly returns Monday for any date (verified with 2026-02-12 → 2026-02-09).
Case-insensitive fridge/grocery comparison works via .lower().strip() — verified.
TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at is set (expireAfterSeconds=0) — sessions auto-purge.
get_current_user() handles missing/invalid/expired token correctly (401 in all cases).
Household isolation is enforced by household_id filter on every collection query — verified via cross-household read tests.
grocery/generate correctly dedupes (second call returns added_count=0) and honors fridge (case-insensitive).
seed_data_creation: For each test, a fresh user + session is seeded in Mongo via the seeded_user / seeded_user_b fixtures (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Fixtures clean up the user, session, and any orphaned household + household-scoped data after each test. Master recipes are seeded by the backend startup hook and were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Frontend (Expo mobile app) has NOT been tested yet — request a frontend testing round when the UI is ready. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). To exercise auth-gated endpoints without real Google OAuth, seed a session directly in Mongo (see /app/backend/tests/conftest.py::_make_user_and_token). /api/auth/session was intentionally SKIPPED because it requires a real Emergent OAuth session_id (per the request note).
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — all tested flows behave as specified in the PRD.
